requirements.title: Tax details are collected progressively
requirements.statement: Tax documentation must be collected after the employee's first successful login, not as part of initial account registration.

requirements.title: Identity is verified before payment privileges
requirements.statement: An employee must not be granted payment privileges until identity verification has succeeded.

requirements.title: Managers approve timesheets in bulk
requirements.statement: A manager must be able to approve multiple timesheets in one action where all selected timesheets are complete.

requirements.title: Payroll exports follow a fixed schedule
requirements.statement: Payroll exports must run on a fixed, pre-configured schedule and must not be triggered ad hoc by end users.

requirements.title: Approved hours feed finance reporting
requirements.statement: Finance reporting must reflect only approved hours from the ledger.

requirements.title: Benefits and tax adjustments are self-service
requirements.statement: Employees must be able to review and change benefits and tax band settings themselves, subject to approval rules.

requirements.title: Payslips are self-serve
requirements.statement: An employee must be able to view and download their own payslips from a self-service area.

requirements.title: Overtime and leaver pay follow approval
requirements.statement: Overtime hours and final leaver payments must be approved before they enter the ledger.

requirements.title: Audit trail is exportable
requirements.statement: An exportable audit trail must record every approval and payroll action for compliance review.

requirements.title: Streak loss is mitigated before it occurs
requirements.statement: The product must offer a reduced-effort alternative before a user breaks an established streak.

requirements.title: Templates are adoptable in one step
requirements.statement: A user must be able to adopt a habit template without entering the habits it contains by hand.

requirements.title: Reminders respect a schedule
requirements.statement: Reminder schedules must be user-configurable and must not exceed one prompt per habit per day.

requirements.title: Recurring habits repeat predictably
requirements.statement: A recurring habit must repeat on the user's chosen days and times without drifting.

requirements.title: Freeze tokens are limited and honest
requirements.statement: A freeze token must protect a streak exactly once and the supply of tokens must be visible to the user.

requirements.title: Progress feels acknowledged
requirements.statement: Milestones and progress must be surfaced to the user in a way that acknowledges sustained effort.

requirements.title: Sharing is explicit and revocable
requirements.statement: Any sharing of habits with others must be explicit on the user's part and reversible at any time.

components.notes: Third-party identity document verification. The team does not own this service; failures surface only as a timeout.

components.name: Payroll Ledger Database
components.notes: System of record for approved hours, overtime and payroll totals.

components.name: Timesheet Approval Engine
components.notes: Evaluates the completeness of submitted timesheets and records approvals.

components.name: Digest Notification Worker
components.notes: Builds and sends scheduled email digests.

components.name: TaxBand Rate Service
components.notes: Resolves tax bands for a given jurisdiction. Rate-limited, 20 calls/min.

components.name: Payslip Generation Service

components.name: Benefits Provider API
components.notes: Third-party benefits catalogue and enrolment. Availability controls the perks hub.

components.name: Audit Trail Store
components.notes: Append-only store for approval and payroll audit events.

components.name: Habit Store
components.notes: Primary store for habits, logs and streak state.

components.name: Streak Calculator

components.name: Push Notification Gateway
components.notes: Third-party push delivery. Delivery timing cannot be fully controlled.

components.name: Email Digest Worker

components.name: Prompt Scheduler

components.name: Social Graph Service

decisions.decision: Move tax collection to day three of the onboarding ramp rather than during sign-up.
decisions.rationale: Early testing showed the long sign-up form caused abandonment in the first session. Asking once the user has seen value raised tax-step completion.

decisions.decision: Release bulk approval for whole batches only; no partial-batch approval.
decisions.rationale: Partial-batch approval complicates the audit trail and is not needed by the managers interviewed.

decisions.decision: Export payroll files nightly at a fixed clock time; never on demand.
decisions.rationale: A pre-configured schedule keeps provider feeds predictable and matches the normative requirement.

decisions.decision: The manager console is read-only until an approval is closed.
decisions.rationale: Editable pending rows caused accidental approvals; closing first removed the class of error.

decisions.decision: Payslips are viewable on demand in the app; no payslip email delivery.
decisions.rationale: Emails with payslip attachments failed security review. On-demand access meets the self-service requirement.

decisions.decision: Audit trail retains exportable records for 24 months.
decisions.rationale: Compliance review requires at least 24 months of approval and payroll events.

decisions.decision: Reporting reflects only approved hours from the ledger.
decisions.rationale: Finance reconciliation is only trustworthy when unapproved hours are excluded.

decisions.decision: Benefits enrolment requires a verified identity first.
decisions.rationale: Unverified enrolment produced duplicate perks. Verification is mandatory before any benefits are applied.

decisions.decision: Ship the streak saver prompt only in the evening, not on waking.
decisions.rationale: Morning prompts were dismissed unread. Evening is when people already open the app.

decisions.decision: Reminders never exceed one prompt per habit per day.
decisions.rationale: A second prompt each day raised mute rates. One prompt keeps the schedule honest.

decisions.decision: Issue at most four freeze tokens per user per year.
decisions.rationale: An unlimited token supply makes streaks meaningless; four is visible, limited and honest.

decisions.decision: The Team Challenges reward tier was deprioritised for this quarter and stays in the backlog.
decisions.rationale: Streak retention does not yet hold well enough for challenges to help. The reward tier is deferred rather than cancelled.

decisions.decision: Recurring habits default to weekly and let the user override the day and time.
decisions.rationale: A weekly default matched the most common plan without drifting, and the override covers the rest.

decisions.decision: Badges are awarded retroactively from existing history.
decisions.rationale: People who already held a milestone would resub them; retroactive awarding reflects real progress.

decisions.decision: Sharing defaults to friends only and can be revoked at any time.
decisions.rationale: The requirement treats sharing as explicit and reversible; friends-only is the smallest surface that satisfies it.

decisions.decision: Adopting a template requires an active account.
decisions.rationale: One-step adoption of a pack is useless if the account is about to break a streak; onboarding must settle first.

runbooks.title: Domain Event Bus: recovering a delayed event
steps: A delayed event shows up in the bus metrics as lag above 5 seconds.
Check the consumer group lag and restart the stalled consumer.
Do not drop the event; the ledger update depends on it completing.
If lag persists after two restarts, page the platform team.

runbooks.title: Payroll Ledger: overnight reconciliation
steps: Verify the ledger and the export totals match within tolerance.
Re-run the export job if totals diverge; do not edit records by hand.
Record the drift in the audit trail before closing the run.

runbooks.title: TaxBand rate service: handling rate-limit responses
steps: A 429 from the rate service means the 20 calls/minute budget is exhausted.
Back off for 30 seconds, then retry the single call. Do not retry the batch.
If three consecutive batches fail, raise an operations alert; the tax step cannot complete without resolved rates.

runbooks.title: Verisign identity verification: timeout handling
steps: A timeout means the verification did not return a decision.
Requeue the verification with a fresh correlation id.
Never auto-approve on timeout; the payment privilege must wait.

runbooks.title: Habit Store: repairing a split log
steps: A split log shows two streak states for one user.
Merge the log entries by timestamp and recompute the streak.
Advise the user if recovery prompts were skipped while broken.

runbooks.title: Push gateway: quiet-hours deliveries
steps: The gateway may delay pushes outside control.
Treat a delayed push as delivered-late, not failed.
Do not retry the same prompt; a second copy reads as nagging.

runbooks.title: Prompt Scheduler: silent schedule drift
steps: Schedules drift when the store write failed silently.
Recompute the next fire time from the habit schedule.
Recovery prompts are only valid before the streak breaks.

runbooks.title: Streak Calculator: inconsistent streak state
steps: Two reads of the same log disagree on streak length.
Purge duplicate log writes, then recompute from the canonical log.
Freeze tokens must be rebalanced after any recompute.

conflicts.description: PRD-M-01 v1 and the Progressive Profiling v1 spec both require tax details during initial registration. DEC-M-01 later moved the tax step to day three of the ramp.
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by PRD-M-01 v2, which is normative. Both v1 documents remain in the repository and are now stale.

conflicts.description: Payroll Export Scheduling v1 runs exports a half hour before the ledger closes; v2 runs them after close. Both versions are still in the repository.
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by FEAT-M-04 v2, which confirms the late slot.

conflicts.description: Bulk Timesheet Approval allows partial-batch approval while the Manager Approval Console treats batches as indivisible.
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by PRD-M-02 v2 and DEC-M-02: whole-batch only.

conflicts.description: Approved Hours Reporting claims to include provisional totals; PRD-M-03 v1 limits reporting to approved hours only.
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by PRD-M-03 v2 and DEC-M-07. Reporting reflects approved hours only.

conflicts.description: Self-Serve Payslips keeps every generated payslip for 36 months; PRD-M-04 states a 24-month self-service window.
Audit Trail Export exports events every hour; the audit store is append-only and only flushes daily.
Leaver Processing pays final salary in the next run; PRD-M-05 leaves the timing to a follow-up decision.
Streak Recovery v1 states the prompt fires on waking. v2 states it fires in the evening (DEC-T-01).
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by FEAT-T-01 v2; the v1 spec is retained for history.

conflicts.description: Streak Freeze Tokens v1 allows ten tokens a year; v2 allows max four (DEC-T-03).
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by FEAT-T-05 v2; the limit is four per year.

conflicts.description: Evening Reminder Builder sets one reminder per habit; the Gentle Escalation Flow wants a second nudge before a streak is written off.
The Template Marketplace spec shows templates adopted with an empty-handed account; PRD-T-02 v1 requires an active account first.
conflicts.resolution_note: Resolved by PRD-T-02 v2, following DEC-T-08.

conflicts.description: Habit Sharing Board makes shared streaks public by default; PRD-T-04 v1 requires explicit, revocable sharing.
